execution_gate.note: can_execute_h6() returns False until a real, correctly-bound external PASS report exists at the versioned path. This package deliberately creates no such report.

evidence_reuse_note: DATASET_DETERMINISM is reused, not re-derived: the full A/B proof re-normalizes 5,691 raw provider files twice (~2.5 h) and its result cannot depend on the executing worktree. The gate validates the durable proof under an explicit binding (proof commit must be an ancestor of HEAD and the normalizer / data-root resolver bytes unchanged) and separately re-executes the layout-sensitive half by resolving the shared data root and recomputing the authority fingerprint from actual bytes. PIT_DYNAMIC is NOT reused from V3: V4 changed the completed-hour aggregation, so it was re-executed against real canonical observations. Portable-data now resolved via shipped resolver; fresh PRE_PREREG, full-verification and clean-worktree runs at d24e427 all PASS with portable layout (no stale evidence reuse for data-dependent gates).
verifier_contract_hard_requirements: Run the independent verifier from a DIFFERENT context/agent than the builder.
Establish PYTHON_IMPORT_AUTHORITY before trusting any project-module result: a bare import inside a worktree can resolve to the main checkout.
Independently recompute the four frozen artifact SHA256 values from Git blobs, not from working-tree copies.

Independently attack the feature-authority boundary (H6FieldAccess AND feature_authority.admitted_observation) and confirm forbidden values are neither stored nor recoverable and that injection fails closed on the real preparation path.
Independently verify the completed-hour window is half-open and yields exactly 12 snapshots.
Independently verify post-freeze immutability via blob IDs AND byte hashes.
Do NOT repair builder artefacts. Record defects and continue independent gates.
reuse_note: V3 DATA_AUTHORITY, DATASET_FINGERPRINT, BTC 2024-06-05 forensic, PIT_DYNAMIC, PRICE_AUTHORITY, PRICE_OVERLAP, CONFIRMATION_LOCK, CONFIRMATION_H6_FIREWALL, SHADOW_INVALIDATION, SHADOW_MATURITY, SHADOW_H6_FIREWALL, PERFORMANCE_CONTAMINATION and H5_IMMUTABILITY evidence remains valid and is reused; no data was rebuilt.

known_non_blocking_limitations.condition: H6 data/result dependency on the confirmation ledger remains NONE

known_non_blocking_limitations.detail: All V4 verification in this package is BUILDER_SELF_VERIFICATION_V4, produced in the same context as the builder. It does not satisfy INDEPENDENT_EXTERNAL_VERIFICATION_V4.
The host-absolute fallback in the three builder harnesses was removed; verifier must probe for the authoritative layout on the host. No effect on src/runtime.
